instruction: We are planning a get-together with our friends and coworkers next week. Buy stuff according to the checklist my partner sent me over email.
notes: Flow: get passwords, find the partner's email via phone contacts (relationship=partner), locate the partner's checklist email in gmail (from_email + query 'checklist'), read the thread to get the attachment id, log into file_system and download the attachment, read the file to learn the checklist entries (product + quantity), then on amazon clear the cart (so pre-existing cart items do not leak into the order), add each checklist product with its quantity, look up the home address id and a payment card id, place the order and complete the task (no answer). The checklist is modeled with three representative entries (item-1..item-3); the real count comes from the file contents and objects/init facts should be instantiated accordingly. Completeness of the cart is enforced in pure STRIPS with an ordered chain (next-item / cart-covers starting from the sentinel checklist-start) so that amazon-place-order requires (cart-covers <last-item>); hence (order-placed) implies every entry was added with the right quantity and the goal/complete-task precondition stay nullary. amazon.search_products is included to resolve product ids from checklist product names; if the checklist already lists product ids the search just confirms them. Address: the order must ship to the supervisor's home address, identified among amazon.show_addresses by name; no address is modified.

warnings: domain: pddl-lib parser: types ['object'] of term Variable(c) are not in available types {'entity', 'payment-card', 'query', 'relationship', 'token', 'username', 'product', 'address', 'password', 'file', 'checklist-item', 'app', 'email', 'attachment', 'person', 'email-thread', 'quantity'}
